pairs.question: Cur cecidere pili?
pairs.answer: Ne ualeam morsu peccare diurno, vincla diurna fero, nocte iubente uagor.
pairs.derivation: The wolf, following the dog and inspecting its neck (gutturque caninum / Respicit), genuinely asks why its fur has fallen off; dropped the speech-tag framing 'et querit:' before the interrogative. The dog (introduced by the tag 'Inquit:', also dropped) answers directly with the two-line reply, taken whole to its full stop. Stopped before the wolf's next speech ('Reddet uerba lupus: Non est michi copia tanti...'), which is a separate turn praising liberty rather than part of the answer.
